interview.hardest_part: Sustaining efficient research, production, exploration, and city development through a dense screenshot-driven interface while managing the long prerequisite chains for later technologies, districts, and buildings within three hours.
interview.likely_failure: Time or action inefficiency will leave the run stuck in the Ancient or Classical Era with queued but unfinished milestones; misclicked production or research choices, slow unit movement, and difficulty satisfying river, coastal, population, and district-placement requirements are the most probable specific blockers.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Turn-based play waits for input, Prince difficulty and one opponent limit pressure, and disabling every victory except Science greatly reduces the chance of an early AI win. Milestones score independently, and the Aztec ability to spend Builder charges to accelerate district construction is especially useful.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Only one ordinary input is available per decision, making technology-tree navigation, production management, and unit orders expensive in wall-clock time. Technologies and buildings have lengthy dependencies, districts require population and suitable tiles, several targets require specific terrain, and barbarians or the AI can disrupt development or eliminate the civilization.
